summary: Checkout requests timed out after a Redis pool-size change.
root_cause: A deployment reduced max_connections below peak concurrent checkout requests.
resolution: Rolled back the deployment and restored the previous Redis pool size.
follow_up: Add a deployment check for Redis connection capacity.

summary: Checkout latency increased while an upstream payment gateway was degraded.
root_cause: The payment gateway exceeded its response timeout.
resolution: Enabled the gateway circuit breaker until the upstream service recovered.
follow_up: Track gateway latency independently from Redis pool saturation.
